alerts.title: Hard Drive Monitor CRITICAL: /dev/sdb ST2000DM008-2FR102
alerts.body:
reallocated sectors: 120 -> 152 (+32)
pending sectors: 16 -> 21 (+5)
offline uncorrectable sectors: 16 -> 19 (+3)
Health 6%  Performance 53%  Status CRITICAL
- 152 reallocated sectors - the drive is remapping bad spots to spare area
- 21 pending sectors - unreadable spots waiting to be remapped; data there may already be lost
- 19 offline uncorrectable sectors - found by the drive's own surface scan and could not be repaired
- 3 reported uncorrectable errors - reads failed even after error correction
- 1 command timeout - the drive stalled on operations (failing drive, cable or power)
